summary: Changes that someone started but never committed no longer go unnoticed.

new.title: A daily reminder of uncommitted changes
new.text: A new daily job finds staged changes and queued actions waiting over a day, with who started them. The list is mailed to your alert recipients with a link to Pending changes.

new.title: You control the reminder
new.text: Switch the mail off under Alerting. A SuperAdmin can change the interval or turn the job off on the Jobs page.
